title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
summary: Talent acquisition specialists fill open roles end to end: they find and screen candidates, arrange interviews, negotiate offers and follow up until joining. They sit in the HR or recruitment team and work closely with hiring managers, reporting on hiring numbers such as time to fill.
dailyDuties: Agree role requirements with hiring managers in intake calls
Source candidates with Boolean search, referrals and resume databases
Screen resumes and run first-round phone screens
Schedule interview rounds and collect panel feedback
Negotiate CTC and joining dates and roll out offers
Update candidate stages in the applicant tracking system
Share weekly hiring pipeline and time-to-fill reports

skills.expectation: Own hiring from requisition to joining for a set of roles
Find active and passive candidates with Boolean search, referrals and databases
Screen resumes and run first-round phone or video screens
Schedule interview rounds and keep candidates informed at each stage
Discuss CTC, notice period and joining date and close offers
Keep every candidate and stage up to date in an applicant tracking system
Track time to fill, offer-to-join ratio and pipeline numbers and report them weekly
Agree role briefs and priorities with hiring managers and keep them updated
Write clear outreach messages and speak confidently with candidates
Plan and run campus drives for entry-level hiring
Help with careers page content and employer brand posts
Start background checks and follow them up before joining
Maintain hiring trackers and simple dashboards in Excel
